syllabus.name: Primary Mathematics Syllabus (Standard Mathematics), implementation starting with 2021 Primary One cohort; SEAB PSLE Mathematics (0008) for Examination from 2026
syllabus.revision: MOE 2021 Primary Mathematics Syllabus (document updated Oct 2025); SEAB 0008 "For Examination from 2026"
syllabus.appliesTo2027Evidence: In 2025, the 2021 primary mathematics syllabus applies to Primary 1 to Primary 5 only. Students in Primary 6 will continue to use the 2013 syllabus. The 2021 mathematics syllabus will be applicable to Primary 6 from 2026 onwards.

papers.name: Paper 1 (Booklet A: multiple-choice; Booklet B: short-answer)

paperFormat.notes: Structured/long-answer questions carry 3, 4 or 5 marks each (40 marks over 10 questions); marksEach=4 is the mean, not an official per-question value. Total 45 questions, 100 marks, 2 h 30 min (SEAB). Both papers on the same day with a break between. MCQ has four options, one correct. Short-answer: 2 marks, or 1 mark per part for two-part questions; 1 mark for correct method on one-part questions with a wrong answer. Foundation Mathematics (PSLE 0038 in SEAB listing) also exists; out of scope here.

unverified.reason: No SEAB "2027 PSLE" Mathematics syllabus document was found on seab.gov.sg (retrieved 2026-11-17). The latest SEAB document is "For Examination from 2026" (0008_y26_sy.pdf), whose wording is open-ended. Applying it to 2027 rests on the MOE sentence that the 2021 syllabus applies to P6 from 2026 onwards, plus the SEAB page title "PSLE formats examined in 2026". A 2027-specific SEAB file may be published later.
Format taken from the SEAB "For Examination from 2026" document. No 2027-specific format statement was found; treat as unchanged unless SEAB publishes otherwise.

SEAB states the exam assesses attainment against the Primary Mathematics syllabus; it does not list examinable content per level or per outcome. All Standard Mathematics outcomes P1-P6 are marked psleExaminable=true on that basis; P1-P3 outcomes are assessed implicitly as prerequisite skills, and the "1-mark MCQ assess basic concepts and skills" sentence is the only explicit hint.
These two flags are the author's judgement, not stated by any official source. Drawing/construction outcomes are marked mcqTestable=false.
Syllabus line "use of ..., 3" under P6 Volume of Cube and Cuboid: symbols were lost in PDF text extraction, so the exact notation is unknown; outcome text is a placeholder and not quiz-ready.
